headline: Russia Strikes Ukrainian Energy Grid as IDF Eliminates Hamas Commanders
subheadline: Russian Geran-5 rockets hit Kyiv energy facility causing water pressure drops in five districts while IDF eliminated Hamas commander Mohammad Mahsen Nur Yazaji in Gaza City airstrike.
lede: Russia launched a massive wave of Geran-5 rockets and Shahed drones across northern and central Ukraine, striking Chernihiv, Rivne, and Kyiv regions. A critical Kyiv energy facility was hit, causing water pressure drops in five districts and sewage disruptions. Meanwhile, Israeli forces conducted multiple airstrikes in Gaza, eliminating Hamas commanders including Mohammad Mahsen Nur Yazaji and Mohammad Fawzi Mohammad Awad Gamal. The Israeli Security Agency disclosed that 72 residents of the Negev and southern areas were arrested in 2026 on suspicion of security offenses and terrorism.

sections.title: Russian Strikes Target Ukrainian Infrastructure
sections.body: Russia launched Geran-5 rockets and Shahed drones across northern and central Ukraine, hitting Chernihiv, Kostopil, and Kyiv region communities. A strike on a key Kyiv energy facility caused water pressure drops in five districts and halted sewage acceptance from Borshchahivka community. Ukrainian drones attacked the Sasta plant and Yandex data center in Ryazan region, and struck Gazprom facilities in Bashkiria. South Korea recalled its ambassador from Ukraine following a dispute over North Korean prisoner-of-war disclosures.

sections.title: IDF Eliminates Hamas Commanders in Gaza
sections.body: Israeli forces conducted multiple airstrikes in Gaza targeting Hamas commanders involved in October 7 attacks and hostage-taking. IDF eliminated Hamas commander Mohammad Mahsen Nur Yazaji in Gaza City and Mohammad Fawzi Mohammad Awad Gamal in the Zabara area. Israeli forces also killed a Hamas militant who infiltrated Israel during the October 7 attacks and participated in the abduction of Sgt. Shaked Dehan's body. The Israeli Security Agency disclosed that 72 residents of the Negev and southern areas were arrested in 2026 on suspicion of security offenses and terrorism.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: Russia's coordinated long-range strikes demonstrate sustained capacity to degrade Ukrainian civilian infrastructure and energy resilience. IDF's targeted eliminations of Hamas commanders indicate continued focus on disrupting organizational leadership. Iran's diplomatic engagement with the US regarding the Hormuz Strait suggests potential de-escalation pathways amid ongoing regional tensions.
